tools.Name: OpenMontage
tools.Description: An open-source, agentic video production system that manages research, scripting, asset generation, editing, and final composition.
tools.Use_Case: Creating cinematic trailers, animated explainers, documentaries, and social media content from text prompts or reference videos.

tools.Name: VoiceStudio
tools.Description: A fully local, open-source alternative to ElevenLabs for voice cloning, dubbing, dictation, and audiobook production.
tools.Use_Case: Offline voice synthesis, local video dubbing, and creating audiobooks in 646+ languages with privacy and zero usage fees.

tools.Name: Crawl4AI
tools.Description: An LLM-friendly, open-source web crawler and scraper that transforms web pages into structured, AI-ready Markdown.
tools.Use_Case: Extracting clean data from websites for RAG pipelines, AI agents, and custom data processing workflows.
